title: Thread-Safe Sliding Window Rate Limiter
specification: Module `rate_limiter` exposes `class RateLimiter` with constructor `RateLimiter(clock=time.monotonic)` where `clock` is a zero-argument callable returning the current time in seconds, and a method `allow(key: str) -> bool` that returns True if the request is accepted and False if it is rejected. The limiter is in-memory and is shared by many threads.
requirements: 60 standard requests per rolling 60-second window per client key.
An additional burst capacity of 10, so no more than 70 accepted requests may exist inside one active window.
State is isolated between client keys.
Rejected requests do not consume capacity.
Concurrent calls never allow capacity to be exceeded.
Time can be injected deterministically through the `clock` constructor argument.
